question.text: Which of the following polymer is a polyamide ?

solution.text: Nylon is a polyamide fibre. It is prepared by the condensation polymerisation of adipic acid (HOOC. $\left.\left(\mathrm{CH}_2\right)_4 \mathrm{COOH}\right)$ and hexamethylene diamine $\left(\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{~N} \cdot\left(\mathrm{CH}_2\right)_6 \cdot \mathrm{NH}_2\right)$.
